maskForm.title: New Facade
maskForm.description: Capture only external presentation such as appearance, build, age impression, and colors, without backstory.
maskForm.editDescription: Update an existing facade while keeping the changes limited to outward presentation, voice, personality, and the board.
maskForm.name: Name
maskForm.introPlaceholder: Summarize outward appearance, personality, speech style, and habits
maskForm.introHint: Do not include backstory, life history, or world relationships.
maskForm.featuresPlaceholder: Use separate lines for visible traits, such as signature gestures, catchphrases, expressions, or visual motifs
maskForm.featuresHint: Only include traits that can be seen, heard, or felt in interaction, without backstory.
maskForm.bodyDescription: Height and weight can be typed directly. Other appearance fields can also be typed directly, with preset suggestions for reference.
maskForm.colorDescription: Use common swatches or fine-tune with the color picker.
maskForm.suggestionsEmpty: No matching suggestions. You can keep typing.
maskForm.saveSuccess: Facade created and added to My Materials.
maskForm.saveFailed: Failed to create the facade. Please try again later.
maskForm.updateFailed: Failed to save facade changes. Please try again later.
maskForm.missingProviderSecret: The default model provider has no API key. Complete it in Experience Settings first.
maskForm.aiDescription: Describe the outward change you want. AI will apply it to the form automatically.
maskForm.aiEmpty: Ask AI to refine appearance, tone, voice values, or personality sliders. It only edits external facade content.
maskForm.aiPlaceholder: Example: Make them colder and more classical, without writing backstory
maskForm.aiMissingDefaultLlm: No usable default LLM is configured. Set one in Experience Settings first.
maskForm.aiFailed: AI assist failed. Please try again later.
maskForm.boardDescription: A 16:9 horizontal board. Uploaded or generated images are saved with the facade.
maskForm.boardEmpty: Click to upload a horizontal board
maskForm.boardGenerateFailed: Failed to generate the character board. Please try again later.
maskForm.boardMissingDefaultImage: No usable default image model is configured. Set one in Experience Settings first.
maskForm.invalidBoardImage: Boards only support PNG/JPG/WebP up to 10MB.
maskForm.voiceDescription: Use continuous sliders to describe audible presentation for future voice or character generation.

pitch.label: Pitch
pitch.description: Sets whether the voice feels deep, mature, girlish, or bright.

volume.label: Volume
volume.description: Sets how present the character sounds.

intonation.label: Intonation
intonation.description: Sets whether speech feels flat or expressive.

emotionExposure.label: Emotion Exposure
emotionExposure.description: Sets how obvious the speaking emotion is.
emotionExposure.low: Very restrained, emotion is hard to hear
emotionExposure.high: Strong emotion, joy is obvious, easily coquettish

nasalResonance.label: Nasal Resonance
nasalResonance.description: Shapes naturalness, soft-girl tone, and streamer feel.

breathiness.label: Breathiness
breathiness.description: Sets how soft, intimate, or sensual the voice feels.

maskForm.personalityDescription: Capture only outward personality, social style, and relationship presentation, without backstory.

extroversion.label: Extroversion
extroversion.low: Slow to warm up, quiet, passive

emotionalStability.label: Emotional Stability
emotionalStability.low: Impatient, easily shaken, easily carried away

boundaries.label: Boundaries
boundaries.high: Slow to warm up, keeps distance

sceneForm.title: New Scene
sceneForm.description: Capture a scene and its sub-area blocks, then generate cubemap panoramas for each block.
sceneForm.editDescription: Update a saved scene material and continue refining blocks or panorama assets.
sceneForm.name: Scene Name
sceneForm.sceneDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe the overall space, atmosphere, layout, exploration focus, and narrative use
sceneForm.blocksDescription: Each block represents a sub-area or viewpoint. Descriptions are required.
sceneForm.blockNamePlaceholder: Example: Main Hall, East Corridor, Rooftop Garden
sceneForm.blockDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe this sub-area's structure, light, materials, interactables, and mood
sceneForm.aiEmpty: Ask AI to complete the scene description, refine blocks, or add and remove blocks directly.
sceneForm.aiPlaceholder: Example: Expand it into an abandoned lab with an archive room and greenhouse
sceneForm.aiMissingDefaultLlm: No usable default LLM is configured. Set one in Experience Settings first.
sceneForm.aiFailed: Scene AI assist failed. Please try again later.
sceneForm.missingProviderSecret: The default model provider has no API key. Complete it in Experience Settings first.
sceneForm.panoramaDescription: Generate a local preview first. Cubemap faces are uploaded only when the scene is saved.
sceneForm.panoramaGeneratedBestEffort: Best available block panorama generated. Seam quality may still need review, so inspect the enlarged preview.
sceneForm.panoramaGeneratedFallback: Block panorama generated. The current model did not perform reference repainting.
sceneForm.panoramaGenerateFailed: Failed to generate the block panorama. Please try again later.
sceneForm.panoramaMissingDefaultImage: No usable default image model is configured. Set one in Experience Settings first.
sceneForm.panoramaQualityFailed: The block panorama did not pass seam quality checks. Regenerate it.
sceneForm.panoramaReferenceEditUnsupported: The default image model does not support reference-image repainting, so it cannot generate production-ready cubemap panoramas. Switch to an image-editing model in Experience Settings.
sceneForm.invalidPanoramaFace: Panorama faces only support PNG/JPG/WebP up to 10MB, and must be square when saved.
sceneForm.panoramaUploadFailed: Failed to upload the cubemap faces. Check the R2 storage settings and try again.
sceneForm.panoramaUploadTooLarge: Failed to upload the cubemap faces. One face is too large, so regenerate or compress it before saving.
sceneForm.migrationRequired: The scene category migration has not been applied yet. Run Prisma migrations before saving the scene.
sceneForm.metadataTooLarge: The scene data is too large for the material record. Reduce blocks or regenerate before saving.
sceneForm.recordSaveFailed: Cubemap faces uploaded, but the scene record could not be saved. The new uploads were cleaned up as best effort; check the database connection or migrations and try again.
sceneForm.saveSuccess: Scene created and added to My Materials.
sceneForm.saveFailed: Failed to save the scene. Please try again later.
sceneForm.updateFailed: Failed to save the scene. Please try again later.
